title: Transitions
summary: GPU shader transitions in the theme's look, shown going from the sample clip to a graphics frame: seven of its own (projector, film and paper: a dip to black with a projector flash, a cold film burn, a slipping film frame, a soft iris, a paper tear, a crimson brush wipe, a book page) and six from the shared set, drawn in the theme's colours (prints with bone edges on the dark table). Run them slower than in other themes: 0.6 to 1 second.
usage: On a shot (the transition INTO it from the shot before): {"transition": {"name": "projector_dip", "seconds": 0.9}}. In a footage storyboard, at a cut such as the start of a full-screen cutaway: "transitions": [{"name": "paper_tear", "at": 7.8, "seconds": 0.7}]. Engine: library/_shared/shader_transitions.py (moderngl); this theme's own shaders and its colours for the shared ones are in transitions/theme_transitions.py.

items.name: projector dip
items.description: The lamp dims with a flicker and a weaving gate, the screen goes dark, a cold flash of the projector catches the middle of the frame, and the next shot comes up out of the dark. The theme default.

items.name: cold burn
items.description: Film burning through in the gate, in cold tones: a ragged hole spreads from one spot, the picture bleaches to steel white ahead of it and the rim chars.

items.name: film slip
items.description: The film slips in the gate: the shot runs up and out, the dark frame line passes, and the next shot seats itself from below in two pulls, with scratches while it moves.

items.name: iris vignette
items.description: A soft-edged iris closes on the shot to the dark, like an old lens, and opens again on the next.

items.name: luma melt
items.description: The bright parts of the picture melt away first with a cold steel fringe, like film running in the gate.

items.name: paper tear
items.description: The shot is a sheet torn away from the left: a deckled edge crosses the frame, leaving pale paper fibre and a shadow on the next shot.

items.name: brush wipe
items.description: Three dry strokes of crimson are dragged across from alternating sides; each covers the shot in paint and thins out to the next one.

items.name: book page
items.description: A page of an old book turns: hinged on the left edge it comes over toward the camera, its free edge curling, pale paper on its back.

items.name: tile flip
items.description: The picture turns over as a grid of cards, like photographs flipped on a table.

items.name: accordion fold
items.description: The frame folds away in vertical pleats like a folded map.

items.name: swing doors
items.description: The picture parts down the middle and swings open onto the next shot.

items.name: slice slide
items.description: Horizontal strips slide apart in alternating directions.

items.name: zoom through
items.description: A fast push through the picture into the next one, with motion blur. For jumps in time.
